title: evals/scenarios/<name>.script.json
description: Canned turns the scripted driver replays in order.

tokens.description: Defaults to the text's length divided by 4, rounded up.

sl.description: sl commands to run in the working root before the turn is recorded, each as its arguments without --root.

write.description: Files the skill writes by hand before its sl commands run, by path relative to the working root (such as goldens/<name>.yaml) to their text. Never under .sl/, never outside the root or through a link, always valid YAML, and never with status: approved or an approval field.
